description: Bounded virtual DCA basket: price-distance or bar-interval additions, hard add/volume/exposure caps, mandatory basket stop.

assumptions.commission: total cash per fill, charged on open and close
assumptions.slippage: points, adverse on every fill including basket stop
assumptions.add_volume: base * multiplier^add_index, clamped by max add volume
assumptions.adds_per_bar: at most one fill per bar; count cap is independent of exposure cap
assumptions.exposure_cap: an add is blocked, never partially filled, when exposure + volume exceeds the cap
assumptions.max_dca_adds_zero: 0 means no additions at all, never unlimited
